title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The AI Office has issued a decision that sets forth new guidelines and standards for the deployment and use of artificial intelligence within the organization. This decision emphasizes ethical practices, transparency, and accountability, aiming to align all AI initiatives with the company’s core values and regulatory requirements.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: The policy outlines the job opening for Technology Specialists in AI, detailing the roles and responsibilities required for the position. It also provides guidance on the qualifications, application process, and compliance standards that candidates and the organization must meet.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: The policy announces the opening for a Lead Scientific Adviser in the AI Office, outlining the role’s responsibilities, required qualifications, and the application process. It also emphasizes the office’s commitment to using scientific expertise to guide AI policy decisions.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: The policy explains how to fill open positions for legal officers in the AI office. It sets out the qualifications, responsibilities, and hiring process to ensure the role supports the organization’s legal and AI compliance needs.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: This document announces a vacancy for an AI Policy Officer and describes the role’s key responsibilities, required qualifications, and how it supports the organization’s AI governance strategy. It also outlines the selection process and expectations for the officer’s contribution to policy development and compliance oversight.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group of experts set up to evaluate and advise on the European Union’s proposed regulations for artificial intelligence. Their goal is to ensure the Act balances innovation with safety, fairness, and ethical considerations.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: The draft requests the creation of uniform standards for AI systems to promote fairness, safety, and transparency across the industry. It proposes shared guidelines and metrics to help developers and regulators maintain consistent, accountable practices.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: This notice announces that a consultation will be held on a new or updated Code of Practice (CoP). Stakeholders are invited to give their input and feedback on the proposed guidelines during this consultation period.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: The document announces a call for members to express interest in joining a Community of Practice focused on AI policy. It invites individuals or organizations to submit their interest and outlines the next steps for participation.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: The document provides a visual overview of the iterative drafting process used by a community of practice (CoP). It explains how policies are repeatedly drafted, reviewed, and refined in successive cycles to reach a final, consensus‑based version.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: The document is a graphic that outlines the timeline of the drafting process for a Community of Practice. It visually depicts key milestones and deadlines, helping stakeholders understand the progression of the policy development and ensuring clear communication of expected completion dates.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: This draft code of practice sets out preliminary guidelines for the responsible design, deployment, and oversight of AI systems, emphasizing principles like transparency, fairness, safety, and accountability. It is intended as a foundational framework for organizations, policymakers, and developers to align AI practices with ethical and regulatory standards.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: This document presents a second draft of guidelines for the responsible use and development of artificial intelligence. It covers key principles such as transparency, fairness, accountability, and safety to help organizations and individuals make ethical decisions when creating or deploying AI systems.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: The Code of Practice: 3rd Draft outlines a set of guidelines and standards for the responsible use of artificial intelligence. It aims to help organizations implement ethical, safe, and compliant AI systems while fostering trust and accountability.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft is a proposed agreement that outlines shared principles for the safe, ethical, and responsible use of artificial intelligence technologies. It seeks to bring together stakeholders to collaborate on guidelines that promote transparency, accountability, and societal benefit while addressing potential risks.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a comprehensive agreement that brings together governments, industry, and civil society to shape the future of artificial intelligence. It sets out principles, standards, and collaborative mechanisms designed to promote safe, transparent, and socially beneficial AI development and use.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: These guidelines list the types of AI behavior and applications that are not allowed, such as creating disinformation, manipulating opinions, or engaging in unfair discrimination. They also explain the consequences for violating these rules and encourage developers to follow ethical standards in their AI projects.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: These guidelines clarify what qualifies as an AI system, detailing the technical and functional criteria used for classification. They help stakeholders uniformly identify and apply policies to various AI applications.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: This policy outlines strategies for communicating and supporting startups to foster innovation. It provides guidance on outreach, collaboration, and resource sharing to help new businesses grow and thrive.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups is a European program that offers high-performance computing resources, funding, and technical support to new and emerging technology companies. It aims to help start-ups accelerate innovation, develop advanced computing solutions, and compete globally by providing access to cutting‑edge HPC infrastructure and expertise.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This slide deck outlines key concepts and strategies for managing risk, covering types of risks, assessment methods, mitigation techniques, and best practices. It is designed to help participants understand how to identify, evaluate, and control potential threats to improve decision‑making and organizational resilience.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This video webinar explains how to identify, assess, and mitigate risks in business operations. It covers best practices and tools for effective risk management.
